meta.method: lds-harvest-auto.mjs run 248y5: resources chosen by the written rules (harvest-log.json meta.rules: formats, dedupe, caps); every feature read (GeoPackage, GeoJSON, shapefile, or table rows with coordinate columns as points, the CRS judged per row by value); a feature is kept when it meets the zone (the 3D model box, BNG E 532400-539900, N 176700-182300): a vertex inside, an edge crossing or the box inside a polygon; whole geometries kept, whole_in_zone and in_cw added; WGS84 6 decimals through OSTN15; contact fields dropped.
